Hero.role: Product-oriented software engineer. I care about details and prioritize user experience.

HomePage.currentFocus: I'm currently building local-first developer tools and turning small product ideas into focused experiments.

AboutPage.paragraph1: Writing, designing, and building are simply different ends of the same line for me. I enjoy frontend development, trying out new technologies, creating small experimental projects, and turning ideas into quick prototypes. Outside of that, I spend my time exploring games, photography, robotics, and 3D design—things that keep my creativity alive.
AboutPage.paragraph2: This site exists to share the inspirations behind my work, the technical details I figure out along the way, and the background of the projects I'm currently exploring. Sometimes it's a game idea, sometimes a visual design experiment, sometimes just a thought that caught my attention during the day… all small notes from my ongoing journey.

seha-studio.description: My personal studio bringing together product surfaces, small open-source tools, AI workflows, and maker experiments. I turn ideas I'm curious about into small experiments, written notes, and tools usable in everyday work.
highlights: Designed and built open-source tools and experiments such as GitScoreLab, PromptTrace, and tr-slugify
Care about the feel of an interface, clean code, and keeping projects understandable over time
Combine frontend engineering, interface design, and product thinking into a single workflow
Maintain a living archive for 3D printing / maker work and field notes

alisgidis.description: Developing comprehensive e-commerce solutions for both web and mobile platforms. Focus on creating scalable, user-friendly applications using cutting-edge technologies to enhance the online shopping experience and drive business growth.
highlights: Developing robust web applications using Next.js & TypeScript for optimal performance
Utilizing shadcn/ui components for modern and intuitive user interfaces
Implementing performance optimizations and responsive design principles across all platforms
Collaborating with design and backend teams to deliver seamless user experiences

gordion.description: Contributed to the development of both B2B and B2C applications in the tourism sector. Focused on delivering seamless and visually appealing user experiences using modern web technologies while ensuring optimal performance and user satisfaction.
highlights: Developed and maintained scalable applications ensuring optimal performance
Leveraged React, Next.js, and jQuery to build dynamic and responsive interfaces
Utilized shadcn and Tailwind CSS for efficient and customizable design implementations
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, user-focused solutions
Continuously improved existing systems, incorporating feedback and optimizing workflows

pikofocus.title: PikoFocus
pikofocus.description: A calm, child-friendly visual focus app with short games for matching colors and shapes, memory, counting, and gentle attention practice. No accounts, no ads, and no child data collection.

sukuntiles.title: SukunTiles
sukuntiles.description: A cozy tile puzzle game made for quiet focus and gentle progress. Explore calm visual worlds, swap tiles into place, and build a personal gallery without timers or noisy distractions.

kaloricam.title: KaloriCam
kaloricam.description: A simple calorie assistant that analyzes a meal photo and shows an estimated calorie value in seconds—without accounts, long forms, or a complicated tracking flow.

soul-garden.title: Soul Garden: Reflex
soul-garden.description: A fast-paced survival game where you dodge obstacles, unlock abilities, and test your reflexes across Normal, Zen, and Twin game modes.

preflint.title: Preflint
preflint.description: An App Store asset checker that validates screenshots, promotional images, and icons directly in your browser, applies safe fixes, and keeps every file local.

clariole.title: Clariole
clariole.description: A CV analysis tool that makes your resume readable by ATS systems and convincing to people. It checks parsing risk, job-description alignment, missing keywords, weak bullets, and recruiter readability — without fake ATS promises.

seha-studio.title: Seha Studio
seha-studio.description: My personal studio and archive site bringing together software, open-source tools, AI workflows, and 3D / maker work. A showcase for selected work, notes, and writing.

registry-doctor.title: RegistryDoctor
registry-doctor.description: A shadcn/ui audit tool that scans setup, tokens, accessibility, component quality, and registry readiness, then turns findings into a focused dashboard and starter registry files.

prompt-trace.title: PromptTrace
prompt-trace.description: Open-source, local-first CLI that scans your AI tool histories, scores every prompt across 6 quality dimensions, extracts reusable templates, and detects workflow patterns.

vue-renderer-tunnel.title: vue-renderer-tunnel
vue-renderer-tunnel.description: A tiny, typed Vue 3 package for routing reactive content between DOM and custom renderer roots such as TresJS—without duplicating the canvas or component tree.

ascii-reveal.title: ASCII Reveal
ascii-reveal.description: An accessible, framework-friendly ASCII text reveal animation library with core, React, and Vue packages.

tr-slugify.title: tr-slugify
tr-slugify.description: NPM package that correctly converts Turkish special characters and creates slugs for URLs.

git-score-lab.title: Git Score Lab
git-score-lab.description: A tool that helps you track your Git contributions and see your progress over time.

code-context-isolation.title: RSC context isolation fix
code-context-isolation.description: I isolated server component renders with AsyncLocalStorage to keep user metrics from leaking across requests.

idea-playlists.title: CSS experiment playground
idea-playlists.description: I am planning a small playground to collect my Tailwind and motion experiments in one place.

note-learning.title: Learn by writing
note-learning.description: Publishing short notes and snippets helps make what I learn stick. The Thoughts page is here to make that habit easier.

book-shoe-dog.title: Shoe Dog – Phil Knight
book-shoe-dog.description: Nike's story made me rethink how product obsession can connect with user experience.
